# IDS Rule Converter 4.0.3

The package description identifies the correct version and uses links that open from PyPI. This version supports Python 3.12 through 3.14.

The converter applies stricter rule admission, tighter HTTP and SIP buffer handling, safer partial outputs, and tighter archive and feed limits. Some rules a prior version accepted may now be rejected. Review the conversion report and validate accepted output with the target engine before deploying an updated ruleset. The documented 4,017-rule corpus was tested with 4.0.0.

The GitHub release includes the standalone runtime, operator documentation ZIP, wheel, source distribution, SPDX SBOM, SHA-256 checksums, and commit-bound release evidence.
